senses.definition: abs. מ׳ a small thing, of city Gn 19:20(×2) (J); of Job’s fortunes, רֵאשִׁיתְךָ מ׳ Jb 8:7 (opp. יִשְׂגֶּה מְאֹד); cstr. מִצְעַר אֲנָשִׁים 2 Ch 24:24 a few men;
of time לַמּ׳ Is 63:18 for the [a] little while.—ψ 42:7 v. ii. מ׳.
